call_points.text: New launch guidance for FY27 held at ₹15,000 Cr of GDV, with launches planned around Diwali and in Q4.
Average realisation rose above ₹17,000/sq ft in Q1 from a little above ₹15,000/sq ft for all of last year.
Land business development for the year is guided at ₹1,500-1,800 Cr, including markets outside Delhi NCR.
Management expects to complete and recognise revenue of over ₹5,000 Cr in FY27.
Construction cost escalation has run at 7-8% a year over the past decade; no unusual spike seen last quarter.
Cash and bank balances are close to ₹2,500 Cr and net debt under ₹390 Cr; net debt may rise modestly with land buys.
On collections timing, management said it cannot name the quarter when sales convert to collections.
Both collections and revenue recognition are guided to cross ₹5,000 Cr each in FY27.
The 5.5 mn sq ft commercial JV with RMZ will incur ₹3,500 Cr to ₹4,000 Cr capex over the next 4 to 4.5 years.
Company targets at least 40% sales absorption upon launching new projects to comfortably cover construction costs.
Net debt was reduced to near zero levels, funded via operational cash flows and proceeds from the RMZ JV transaction.
FY26 average sales realisations crossed ₹15,000 per sq ft, up over 20% YoY, led by a higher mix of premium group housing.
Net debt reduced to ₹2.0 Bn as of March 31, 2026, from ₹8.8 Bn in the previous year.

operating_notes.text: Acquired 1.28 acres of land in Sector-71, Gurugram, out of a total 4.26 acres collaboration.
NSE Sustainability revised ESG rating to 65 for FY24-25 due to a construction site incident.
Average sales realization stood at ₹15,250 per sq. ft. in FY26 versus ₹12,457 per sq. ft. in FY25.
FY26 pre-sales were ₹82.5 bn (2,124 units, 5.41 mn sq ft) versus ₹102.9 bn (4,130 units, 8.26 mn sq ft) in FY25.
The company received ₹12.37 bn of the ₹12.93 bn consideration for the sale of a 50% stake in a subsidiary to the RMZ group.
FY26 pre-sales stood at ₹82.5 Bn across 5.4 mn sq ft with an average realization of ₹15,250 per sq ft.
Signatureglobal expects ₹3,500 Cr to ₹4,000 Cr capex over 4-4.5 years for the 5.5 mn sq ft commercial project developed jointly with RMZ Group.
Portfolio GDV across launched projects (21+ mn sq ft) and land resources (19 mn sq ft) exceeds ₹70,000 Cr.
Q1FY27 average realisation was over ₹17,000/sq ft against a little above ₹15,000/sq ft for all of FY26, helped by the Tonino Lamborghini launch at over ₹22,000/sq ft.
About 23 million sq ft launched since February 2024 carries a GDV of ₹334 billion, of which ₹230-240 billion of sales has been achieved.
A forthcoming portfolio of about 17 million sq ft includes 5 million sq ft of commercial development tied up with the RMZ group, announced in March.

timeline.summary: Signatureglobal executed two sale deeds to purchase 1.28 acres of land at Sector-71, Gurugram, with a developable area of ~0.10 million sq ft.
On May 1, 2026, Signatureglobal informed the exchange of a revised ESG rating of 65 by NSE Sustainability for FY24-25 following a site incident.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,107.27 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,152.41 Cr.
Signatureglobal released its FY26 investor presentation outlining FY27 pre-sales guidance of ₹100 Bn and revenue recognition guidance of ₹50 Bn.
Signatureglobal (India) Limited’s **M R Bothra** shared the Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording on 14 May 2026 via the company’s website.
In its Q4FY26 earnings call, Signatureglobal reiterated FY27 pre-sales guidance exceeding ₹10,000 Cr and outlined over ₹15,000 Cr of new project launches.
On 6 August 2026 Signatureglobal's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 guidance at ₹10,000 Cr pre-sales and ₹15,000 Cr of new launches, after about ₹2,000 Cr of pre-sales and ₹670 Cr of collections in the quarter.
